title: No README.md with setup and run instructions
evidence: run_dir listing shows only TASK.md, go.mod, go.sum, main.go, main_test.go, scores.json, stack.json (+ logs); no README* file present
suggestion: Add a README.md documenting `go mod download`, `go run .`, the endpoints, and `go test ./...`

title: Fewer than 3 tests (only 2 present)
evidence: main_test.go:33 TestCreateAndGetBook and main_test.go:62 TestListBooksFilter are the only test functions; spec asks for at least 3
suggestion: Add a third test (e.g. PUT update, DELETE, validation-rejection, or 404 path)

title: Tests share a persistent /tmp/books_test.db across runs
evidence: main_test.go:17 uses fixed dbFile /tmp/books_test.db and never truncates; TestListBooksFilter asserts len(list)==1 for author=X which can break on re-run accumulation
suggestion: Use t.TempDir() or an in-memory :memory: DB per test

title: /health returns plain text 'OK', not JSON
evidence: main.go:62-65 writes []byte("OK") with no Content-Type; endpoint exists and returns 200 so requirement is met
suggestion: Return JSON like {"status":"ok"} for consistency with other routes
